PRENATAL GENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient Name: [redacted name]
Date of Birth: [redacted date]
Medical Record Number: [redacted ID]
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Referring Physician: Dr. [redacted name]
Date of Collection: [redacted date]
Date of Report: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INFORMATION
Maternal age: 34 years
Gestational age: 16 weeks (by ultrasound dating)
Indication for testing: Prenatal screening for chromosomal trisomies
Specimen type: Amniotic fluid

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR)
Chromosome-specific trisomy screening for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21

METHODOLOGY
QF-PCR analysis was performed on uncultured amniocytes using fluorescently labeled primers for chromosome-specific short tandem repeat (STR) markers. Multiple informative markers were analyzed for each chromosome:
- Chromosome 13: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S628
- Chromosome 18: D18S535, D18S391, D18S390, D18S386
- Chromosome 21: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1437

RESULTS
Chromosome 13: Normal diallelic pattern observed
Chromosome 18: Normal diallelic pattern observed
Chromosome 21: Normal diallelic pattern observed

INTERPRETATION
PCR analysis is consistent with a normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. No evidence of trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), or trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) detected.

LIMITATIONS
This test screens only for trisomies of chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. Other chromosomal abnormalities, including structural rearrangements, mosaicism below 20%, and abnormalities of other chromosomes, would not be detected by this analysis.

RECOMMENDATIONS
Full karyotype analysis from cultured amniocytes to follow. This will provide comprehensive chromosomal analysis including all chromosomes and structural abnormalities.

This test was developed and its performance characteristics determined by [redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD
